info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Loyalty Loyalty Partners-v3-spec
info.description: The Loyalty Partners Listing API provides businesses with access to a comprehensive list of loyalty partners associated with their programs. By utilizing this endpoint, developers can retrieve detailed information about each partner, including program specifics and partnership benefits. This API is designed for businesses looking to enhance customer engagement through loyalty initiatives. Typical consumers include marketing teams and application developers integrating partner data into their platforms, aiming to maximize customer loyalty and rewards engagement.

get.summary: Retrieve a list of loyalty partners.
get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch all available loyalty partners, providing essential information such as partner name, type, and available offers. Ideal for users looking to explore collaboration opportunities with partners or for customers wanting to understand their loyalty options.
